body: Original T_RoRu_Body_D/N/ORM; no global body opacity because its mask contains nontransparent coverage data.
cloth: Original T_RoRu_2012Cloth_D and T_RoRu_Cloth_N; no matching 2012 ORM supplied, conservative dielectric fallback.
hair: Original shared T_Hair_D/N with BoRu original opacity packed into diffuse alpha; no generated recoloring.
eyes: Original iris disc placed in a sclera atlas; planar corneal UV prevents the pupil covering the entire eye. Flat normal and conservative gloss. Separate sclera and original-opacity lash cards.
mouth: Body atlas wraps original U tile offset; original dedicated mouth shader not supplied.
glass: Original 36-face lens mesh; neutral tint and 20 percent alpha matching original preview specification; shader appearance requires game check.
accessory: Neutral gray for 10 untextured accessory faces; textured watch/frame pieces retain cloth atlas.
normal_convention: Runtime DirectX maps retained; Blender preview flips green for its tangent convention.
